name: Get SMS creation flow status
description: Call this when you need to know which SMS campaign creation experience the account is on before building or editing an SMS campaign, so you can pick the right follow-on action or UI route. The response also tells you whether a sender phone number is configured. This only reports flow configuration — to list or read actual SMS campaigns, use the campaigns listing action instead, and to create one, use the SMS campaign creation action.
preconditions: An authenticated Brevo web app session is required.
The request is served by the unified-campaign-creation.brevo.com host, not the public API host.

unified_sms_creation_flow_enabled.description: True when the account uses the unified SMS campaign creation flow; false when it uses the legacy flow.

phone_number.description: The phone number associated with the SMS flow for this account. Empty string when none is configured.
